meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把通道连接到智能体分组,管理隔离级别,新增通道分组
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要管理多个智能体分组,并需要控制它们之间的通道和隔离。
copy.tagline_en: Connect channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, and add channel groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple agent groups and need to control channel wiring and isolation.

howto.what: 帮你把消息渠道(如 Telegram、Slack)接到 agent 组,选择会话隔离方式,并把接线配置写进数据库。也能新增渠道群组、改接法和查看当前配置。
howto.when: 在添加新渠道之后、初始设置期间,或你想单独重新配置渠道接线时接管。若实例还没有 owner,它会先让你运行 /init-first-agent。

say.text: 帮我看看现在有哪些渠道已经接线,哪些还没配置
say.note: 它会读取数据库并列出分类清单

say.text: 把这个新的 Telegram 群接到 my-agent 这个 agent 组
say.note: 选完隔离方式后会写入 wiring

say.text: 把 Slack 渠道从旧 agent 组改接到新组
say.note: 旧会话留在原组,新消息走新组

howto.what_en: Wires messaging channels such as Telegram and Slack to agent groups, sets the session isolation level, and writes the wiring to the database. Also adds new channel groups, changes existing wiring, and shows the current configuration.
howto.when_en: Runs after you add a channel, during initial setup, or standalone when you want to reconfigure wiring. If the instance has no owner yet, it tells you to run /init-first-agent first.

say_en.text: Show me which channels are wired and which are not configured yet
say_en.note: It reads the DB and lists them by category

say_en.text: Wire this new Telegram group to the my-agent agent group
say_en.note: It asks for isolation, then writes the wiring

say_en.text: Move the Slack channel from the old agent group to the new one
say_en.note: Old sessions stay; new messages route to the new group
